onepager.title: AI 보조기구 확산과 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
onepager.sourceLine: 최근 여러 기업들이 AI 보조기구를 확장하며 시장 점유율을 높이고자 하는 전략을 세우고 있음.
onepager.scope: 스마트폰, 태블릿, 웨어러블 기기, 서비스 수익화
onepager.thesis: AI 보조기구의 성장은 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상과 함께 경쟁력 강화의 기회를 제공한다.

insights.title: AI 보조기구의 사용자 접근성 증가
insights.body: AI 보조기구의 제공 범위가 확대됨에 따라 사용자 수가 증가할 것으로 예상된다. 이는 서비스 성과 개선으로 이어져 경쟁력을 강화할 가능성이 있다.

insights.title: 효율적인 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
insights.body: AI 보조기구로 인해 온디바이스 AI의 성능이 향상될 수 있다. 이는 사용자 경험 개선과 연계되어 시장 점유율 확대에 기여할 것이다.

insights.title: AI 기술의 경제적 가치 증대
insights.body: AI 조기 도입으로 인해 기업의 운영 효율성이 개선되고 있으며, 이는 서비스 수익화와 직결된다. AI 투자에 대한 긍정적인 결과가 기대된다.

insights.title: 경쟁사 대응 전략 필요성
insights.body: AI 보조기구에 대한 대응 전략이 필요하다. 경쟁사와의 차별화를 통해 시장에서의 위치를 더욱 강화할 수 있다.

metrics.t: AI 모델 및 플랫폼 시장 규모 예상
AI 플랫폼 및 모델 시장 성장률
CFO들이 AI 투자의 생산성 향상 경향

implications.text: 온디바이스 AI와 연결된 서비스 모델 개발이 필요하다.
AI 효율성을 높이기 위한 부품 조달 전략 강화가 필수적이다.
패러다임 변화에 맞춘 경쟁 전략 수립이 필요하다.
AI 기술을 접목한 혁신적인 제품 개발이 중요하다.

onepager.conclusion: AI 보조기구의 확산은 단말 사업의 성과에 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상된다. 온디바이스 AI의 성능 향상은 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 요소가 될 것이다.
onepager.watch: AI 관련 규제가 기업의 혁신과 경제성에 미치는 영향을 면밀히 검토해야 한다.

feed.titleEn: JPMorgan Raises S&P 500 Target to 8,000 as Earnings and AI Growth Strengthen Outlook
feed.descEn: JPMorgan has increased its 2026 S&P 500 price target to 8,000 from 7,800, pointing to an exceptionally strong second-quarter earnings season and growing evidence that massive artificial intelligence investments are translating into stronger business performance. The bank also raised its earnings forecasts for both 2026 and 2027, although elevated interest rates, geopolitical risks and heavy capital-market supply are keeping its valuation assumptions in check.

Instead, the higher index target is primarily being driven by stronger earnings expectations.

feed.title: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall
feed.desc: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall    IDC | Trusted Tech Intelligence

sourceContent.headline: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall
sourceContent.description: Memory-driven price hikes just drove tablet shipments down 12.3% YoY. IDC's Q2 2026 Tracker data shows where demand is holding and what vendors do next.
paragraphs: A Brutal Quarter, and a Bigger Question About Relevance Worldwide tablet shipments fell to 33.6 million units in the second quarter of 2026, down 5.2% from the prior quarter and 12.3% from a year ago , according to IDC’s Worldwide Quarterly Personal Computing Device Tracker .
IDC’s own PCD Forecast Assumptions had already flagged this inflection point across two consecutive quarterly cycles, projecting shipment declines accelerating from 2026Q2 onward.
Worldwide tablet shipments fell 5.2% QoQ and 12.3% YoY in Q2 2026, the category’s steepest YoY decline this cycle, driven by the memory (DRAM/NAND) supply shortage.

IDC’s own PCD Forecast Assumptions had already flagged this inflection point across two consecutive quarterly cycles, projecting shipment declines accelerating from 2026Q2 onward.

Worldwide tablet shipments fell 5.2% QoQ and 12.3% YoY in Q2 2026, the category’s steepest YoY decline this cycle, driven by the memory (DRAM/NAND) supply shortage.

localization.title: 태블릿 시장이 벽에 부딪혔
summaryLines: 잔인한 분기, 그리고 타당성에 대한 더 큰 질문 IDC의 Worldwide Quarterly Personal Computing Device Tracker에 따르면 2026년 2분기 전세계 태블릿 출하량은 3,360만 대로 전 분기 대비 5.2%, 1년 전 대비 12.3% 감소함
IDC의 자체 PCD 예측 가정은 이미 두 분기 연속 주기에 걸쳐 이 변곡점을 표시했으며, 2026년 2분기부터 출하량 감소가 가속화될 것으로 예상함

feed.title: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi
feed.desc: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi    South China Morning Post

sourceContent.headline: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi
sourceContent.description: Beijing can weather current trade friction but tightening restrictions on open-weight models complicate outlook, analysts say.
paragraphs: The US-China direct bilateral AI trade has largely decoupled – with Chinese AI-related exports to the US falling 4.1 per cent year on year between January and June, shaving 0.5 percentage points off overall export growth – and Citi analysts noted that China remained an indirect beneficiary of the broader global AI boom.
The analysts estimated that a full AI decoupling, considered an extreme-case scenario, could place up to 9.2 per cent of China’s exports at risk.

Beijing can weather current trade friction but tightening restrictions on open-weight models complicate outlook, analysts say As US-China tech tensions rise ahead of an expected leadership summit next month, analysts argue Washington’s latest restrictions are unlikely to cause a major disruption in China’s AI exports.

summaryLines: 1월부터 6월까지 중국의 AI 관련 대미 수출이 전년 동기 대비 4.1% 감소해 전체 수출 증가율이 0.5%포인트 감소하는 등 미중 직접 양자 AI 무역은 크게 분리되었으며, Citi 분석가들은 중국이 더 광범위한 글로벌 AI 붐의 간접적인 수혜자로 남아 있다고 지적함
분석가들은 극단적인 시나리오로 간주되는 완전한 AI 분리가 중국 수출의 최대 9.2%를 위험에 빠뜨릴 수 있다고 추정함
중국은 현재의 무역 마찰을 극복할 수 있지만 개방형 모델에 대한 제한 강화로 인해 전망이 복잡해진다고 분석가들은 말함 · 다음 달로 예정된 리더십 정상회담을 앞두고 미중 기술 긴장이 고조됨에 따라 분석가들은 워싱턴의 최근 제한이 중국의 AI 수출에 큰 차질을 초래할 가능성은 낮다고 주장함

feed.title: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment
feed.desc: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs says the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence investment in the United States could be starting to displace spending elsewhere in the economy, although the bank has found relatively little evidence of a widespread crowding-out effect so far. With AI-related investment approaching hundreds of billions of dollars annually, analysts are increasingly examining whether the boom is diverting capital, construction resources and financing away from other business activities.
summaryLinesEn: Goldman Sachs analyst Jessica Rindels estimates that U.S. investment in artificial intelligence will reach almost $600 billion in 2026, "equivalent to nearly 2% of US GDP."

That issue is particularly relevant because a significant portion of AI spending is directed towards imported technology equipment, potentially limiting the amount of investment that translates directly into domestic economic activity.

Goldman Sachs says the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence investment in the United States could be starting to displace spending elsewhere in the economy, although the bank has found relatively little evidence of a widespread crowding-out effect so far.

feed.title: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”
feed.desc: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”    Supply Chain Digest

sourceContent.headline: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”
paragraphs: The IDC InfoBrief, which surveyed more than 2,000 supply chain leaders across nine global markets, found that while AI adoption is nearly universal - only 2% of respondents report no AI-enabled capabilities, and just 12% consider themselves AI leaders.
Roles will shift, not shrink. 79% see AI as an opportunity over threat, and partners with AI plus supply chain depth will win.

The research also points to a sharp acceleration in expectations for autonomous decision-making: just 6% of respondents describe their supply chains as autonomous at scale today, but 41% expect that to become their core operating model within one to two years - even though only 1 in 8 organizations has governance fully embedded to support it.

feed.titleEn: RBC wins IDC CIO Awards Canada 2026 for AI-driven credit underwriting transformation
feed.descEn: Royal Bank of Canada (TSX: RY) (NYSE: RY) has been named an IDC CIO Awards Canada 2026 winner for retail credit underwriting, an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted digital transformation program. The initiative is one of several that will help achieve the organization's bold ambition to generate $700 million to $1 billion in enterprise value from AI benefits by 2027.
summaryLinesEn: As Canada's biggest bank and one of the largest in the world, based on market capitalization, we have a diversified business model with a focus on innovation and providing exceptional experiences to our more than 19 million clients in Canada, the U.S. and 27 other countries.
The initiative is one of several that will help achieve the organization's bold ambition to generate $700 million to $1 billion in enterprise value from AI benefits by 2027.
Early results from the program, which enables the bank to look beyond traditional credit models, include improved approval rates, accelerated decision timelines and increased client acquisition.

feed.title: Supply Chain AI Deployed by 88%, Governed by 12%: IDC Finds Trust Is Real Barrier
feed.desc: Supply Chain AI Deployed by 88%, Governed by 12%: IDC Finds Trust Is Real Barrier    techtimes.com
feed.titleEn: Supply Chain AI Deployed by 88%, Governed by 12%: IDC Finds Trust Is Real Barrier
feed.descEn: Supply chain AI governance lags far behind deployment: a 2,000-leader IDC study finds only 12% of supply chain organizations have embedded governance, while 41% expect to operate as fully autonomous
summaryLinesEn: The survey, which covered more than 2,000 supply chain leaders across nine global markets, found that only 12% of organizations have AI planning governance fully embedded in their operations — while 41% expect autonomous AI to become their core operating model within one to two years.

A new IDC study released Wednesday found that 88% of supply chain organizations have deployed AI but lack the governance infrastructure to oversee it responsibly — a gap made urgent by an approaching regulatory hard stop: the EU AI Act's full compliance obligations for high-risk AI systems take effect December 2, 2027, and most operators have barely started.

EU Act's December 2027 Deadline: Sixteen Months and Counting The EU AI Omnibus, which entered force July 27, 2026, extended compliance for standalone Annex III high-risk AI systems from the original August 2, 2026 date to December 2, 2027 — giving supply chain operators additional runway but not eliminating the obligation.

feed.titleEn: UBS and FactSet make strategic investment in Finster AI - The TRADE
feed.descEn: The funding forms part of Finster AI’s Series B financing round, and is set to support research, analysis and content workflows for investment banking and asset management.
summaryLinesEn: Finster AI’s is specifically aimed at research, analysis and content workflows across investment banking and asset management.
UBS Investment Bank has made a strategic investment into Finster AI, set to support the development of AI-native workflows, secure enterprise systems and data infrastructure.

feed.descEn: By Vagesha Sinha, AVP – GCC Practice
summaryLinesEn: The bottleneck is no longer AI adoption but it is industry’s habit of treating visible AI activity as proof of enterprise advantage.
Advantage shows up when a GCC can prove that its data moved a recurring business decision faster, better, or more profitably than before.
According to AI-first Global Capability Centers Index 2026 , AI is used by almost all surveyed Indian GCCs, yet meaningful business impact remains elusive for nearly two-thirds of the industry.

localization.title: GCC는 AI 채택을 AI 이점으로 착각하고 있음
summaryLines: 병목 현상은 더 이상 AI 채택이 아니라 가시적인 AI 활동을 기업 이점의 증거로 간주하는 업계의 습관임
장점은 GCC가 데이터가 반복적인 비즈니스 결정을 이전보다 더 빠르고, 더 좋게, 더 수익성 있게 움직였다는 것을 증명할 수 있을 때 나타남
AI 우선 글로벌 역량 센터 지수 2026에 따르면 조사 대상 인도 GCC의 거의 모든 곳에서 AI를 사용하고 있지만 업계의 약 2/3에서는 여전히 의미 있는 비즈니스 영향을 파악하기 어렵음

summaryLinesEn: Bank of America’s Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates In the past six months, BAC shares have gained 21.8% compared with the industry ’s 16.5% growth.
AI’s second wave is moving from infrastructure to implementation and these companies are at the forefront of this transition, positioned to become what Amazon and Google were to the internet era.
Morgan Stanley is working with Mythos Preview to improve its cybersecurity infrastructure, highlighting the need to address security risks associated with frontier AI models.

localization.title: Bank of America의 사이버 보안 투자 · 전략적 움직임
summaryLines: Bank of America의 가격 성과, 평가 및 추정 지난 6개월 동안 BAC 주가는 업계 16.5% 성장에 비해 21.8% 상승함
AI의 두 번째 물결은 인프라에서 구현으로 이동하고 있으며 이러한 기업은 이러한 전환의 최전선에 있으며 Amazon과 Google이 인터넷 시대에 그랬던 것처럼 자리매김하고 있음
Morgan Stanley는 Mythos Preview와 협력하여 사이버 보안 인프라를 개선하고 최첨단 AI 모델과 관련된 보안 위험을 해결해야 할 필요성을 강조하고 있음

sourceContent.headline: Goldman Sachs warns AI investment may be crowding out other business spending
sourceContent.description: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs said the surge in artificial intelligence spending may be crowding out other business activity, though it found only limited evidence of that effect so far.
paragraphs: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs said the surge in artificial intelligence spending may be crowding out other business activity, though it found only limited evidence of that effect so far.
Rindels believes the rapid growth raises the question of whether it is displacing other spending, particularly because so much AI outlay goes on imported technology goods.

In a note to clients, analyst Jessica Rindels estimated AI investment in the U.S. will total almost $600 billion in 2026, "equivalent to nearly 2% of US GDP," and has amounted to over 10% of business fixed investment in recent quarters.

sourceContent.headline: JPMorgan Strategists Raise S&P 500 Target as AI Capex Pays Off
sourceContent.description: (Bloomberg) -- JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists raised their S&P 500 Index forecast for a second time in two months, citing strong corporate earnings and the payoff from massive artificial intelligence spending. paragraphs: The JPMorgan strategists expect AI spending to keep climbing, with the technology projected to account for well over half of total capex of $1.5 trillion across the S&P 500 this year, a proportion that's tipped to grow.

Iran Shakes Up Security Team After Saying Oman Deal 'Very Close' China Unleashes $28 Trillion Capital Markets to Challenge US in AI Stocks Hold Near Record Highs, Oil Ticks Higher: Markets Wrap Trump Amps Up Pressure on Billionaire Sargeant to Exit Venezuela Iran Says Hormuz Deal Close But Its Conditions Must Be Met The team led by Dubravko Lakos-Bujas now sees the US benchmark rising to 8,000 points, implying gains of about 3% from Friday's close.
The second-quarter earnings season has produced evidence that capital expenditure by the so-called AI hyperscalers is being monetized through customer demand, the JPMorgan team said.

localization.title: JPMorgan 전략가, AI Capex 성과로 S&P 500 목표 상향
summaryLines: JP모건 전략가들은 올해 S&P 500 전체에서 AI 기술이 전체 자본 지출 1조 5000억 달러의 절반 이상을 차지할 것으로 예상하면서 AI 지출이 계속 증가할 것으로 예상하고 있으며, 이 비율은 증가할 것으로 예상됨

이란, 오만 협상 '매우 성사'라고 말한 후 보안 팀 흔들기 중국, AI 주식에서 미국에 도전하기 위해 28조 달러 규모의 자본 시장 공개 사상 최고치에 근접하고 유가 상승 · 시장은 트럼프가 억만장자 사전트에게 베네수엘라를 떠나도록 압력을 가함 이란은 호르무즈 협상이 성사되었지만 조건이 충족되어야 한다고 말함 Dubravko Lakos-Bujas가 이끄는 팀은 이제 미국 벤치마크가 8,000포인트로 금요일 종가 대비 약 3%의 상승을 의미함
JPMorgan 팀은 2분기 실적 시즌에 소위 AI 하이퍼스케일러의 자본 지출이 고객 수요를 통해 수익화되고 있다는 증거를 제시했다고 말함

feed.desc: Citi Recommends Buying the Dip in Memory Stocks as AI Cycle Gains Momentum    Yahoo Finance

sourceContent.headline: Citi Recommends Buying the Dip in Memory Stocks as AI Cycle Gains Momentum
sourceContent.description: Citi believes the recent sell-off in memory chip stocks presents a buying opportunity, arguing that the artificial intelligence-driven memory cycle is still in its early phases and could ultimately exceed the industry’s previous boom between 2001 and 2007. The bank says the current environment shares many similarities with the long NAND expansion seen during the early 2000s, when products such as MP3 players and digital cameras transformed demand and flash memory steadily replaced older storage
paragraphs: The bank said the current cycle "is likely to outperform the '01–'07 upcycle given that AI demand is driving both DRAM and NAND demand."
The bank estimates total HBM capacity per AI system will increase by 434%, rising from 20.7 terabytes to 110.6 terabytes as the number of GPUs per system grows from 72 to 576.

Citi believes the recent sell-off in memory chip stocks presents a buying opportunity, arguing that the artificial intelligence-driven memory cycle is still in its early phases and could ultimately exceed the industry's previous boom between 2001 and 2007.

summaryLines: 은행은 AI 수요가 DRAM과 NAND 수요를 모두 주도하고 있다는 점을 고려할 때 현재 주기가 '01~'07년 업사이클을 능가할 가능성이 높다고 말함

Citi는 최근 메모리 칩 주식의 급락이 매수 기회를 제공한다고 믿고 있으며, 인공 지능 기반 메모리 사이클은 아직 초기 단계에 있으며 궁극적으로 2001년에서 2007년 사이에 업계의 이전 호황을 넘어설 수 있다고 주장함

feed.title: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026
feed.desc: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026    Goldman Sachs
feed.titleEn: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs Research adjusted widely cited measures of capital expenditure by US hyperscale tech companies to develop a more comprehensive estimate of AI investment around the world.
summaryLinesEn: That projection points to $1 trillion of AI-related investment around the globe in 2026, including $581 billion in the US, writes Joseph Briggs, who co-leads the Global Economics team, in a report.
There is also some risk of double-counting capex for AI for some companies that do not report property, plant, and equipment investment separately from financial leases in their capex statements.

Those estimates imply that AI capex will rise from 1.8% of GDP in the US (with global AI investment totaling 0.9% of global GDP) in 2026 to 2.5% of GDP in the US (1.3% globally) in 2027, with a further increase to 2.8% (1.4% globally) in 2028.

localization.title: 2026년에는 전 세계 AI 투자가 1조 달러를 넘을 것으로 예상됨
summaryLines: 글로벌 경제팀의 공동 책임자인 Joseph Briggs는 보고서에서 이 예측에 따르면 2026년에는 미국의 5,810억 달러를 포함하여 전 세계적으로 AI 관련 투자가 1조 달러에 달할 것이라고 밝힘
또한 자산, 플랜트 및 장비 투자를 자본 지출 명세서에 금융리스와 별도로 보고하지 않는 일부 기업의 경우 AI에 대한 자본 지출을 이중 계산할 위험이 있음
이러한 추정치는 AI 자본 지출이 2026년 미국 GDP의 1.8%(전 세계 AI 투자는 전 세계 GDP의 0.9%)에서 2027년 미국 GDP의 2.5%(전 세계 1.3%)로 증가하고, 2028년에는 2.8%(전 세계 1.4%)로 추가 증가할 것임을 의미함

feed.desc: Bank of America’s ‘Robust’ AI Data Center Deal Pipeline: Q&A    BloombergNEF
feed.titleEn: Bank of America’s ‘Robust’ AI Data Center Deal Pipeline: Q and A | BloombergNEF
feed.descEn: Bank of America says AI infrastructure financing remains robust as demand grows across data centers, power and compute.
summaryLinesEn: Bank of America has a “robust” pipeline across the three key pillars of data center development – buildings, power supply and compute equipment – according to Karen Fang, global head of infrastructure and sustainable finance.
For example, AI training tasks can be shifted to regions experiencing surplus renewable generation and scaled back in areas facing power constraints.

Over time, improved efficiency could reduce the need for additional power generation capacity, lower operating costs, and help address community concerns about the energy footprint of large-scale data center projects.

localization.title: Bank of America의 '강력한' AI 데이터 센터 딜 파이프라인 · Q&A | 블룸버그NEF
summaryLines: 인프라 및 지속 가능한 금융 부문 글로벌 책임자인 Karen Fang에 따르면 Bank of America는 데이터 센터 개발의 세 가지 주요 기둥인 건물, 전원 공급 장치 및 컴퓨팅 장비에 걸쳐 "강력한" 파이프라인을 보유하고 있음
예를 들어, AI 교육 작업은 잉여 재생 가능 발전이 있는 지역으로 이전되고 전력 제약이 있는 지역에서는 축소될 수 있음
시간이 지남에 따라 효율성이 향상되면 추가 발전 용량의 필요성이 줄어들고, 운영 비용이 낮아지며, 대규모 데이터 센터 프로젝트의 에너지 사용량에 대한 지역 사회의 우려를 해결하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

feed.title: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI
feed.desc: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI    thestack.technology
feed.titleEn: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI
feed.descEn: + "Tokenomics" is here, AMD rises then falls, and SpaceXAI reveals AI revenue figures for the first time.
summaryLinesEn: That's a 213% jump since the previous quarter, and driven largely by the big compute deal it signed with Anthropic that was a big part of its $1.6 billion in revenue from "AI infrastructure."

A pragmatist with a $14b budget: The Stack sat down with Bank of America’s chief technology and information officer Hari Gopalkrishnan at the bank's London office to discuss his measured approach to the current agent madness (“People are going a little crazy”), as well as going into detail about revamping the bank’s AI chatbot Erica to be more cost-effective, and his platform plans.

We're convening in London on November 4-5, for a series of exclusive workshops and fireside conversations on the rise of BYOC as a favoured enterprise SaaS deployment model; how many CDOs are consolidating their data estates with Apache Iceberg; how CISOs at FTSE 100 scale are handling supply chain risk (with GSK's CISO) and more.

feed.title: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC
feed.desc: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC    Windows Latest

sourceContent.headline: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC
sourceContent.description: IDC says Apple's MacBook Neo is pressuring Microsoft to build a more efficient Windows 11, as PC shipments fall and RAM prices soar in 2026.
paragraphs: At least, it’s better than the absurdly priced Surface Laptop for Business with 8GB RAM selling for $1,299, more than double the Neo’s price!.

Two months after the MacBook Neo launched, a Microsoft-commissioned benchmark against the Neo found every OEM Windows machine tested shipped with double the RAM, more storage, and better port selection than Apple’s 8GB, 256GB, USB 2.0-bottlenecked machine.
Apple’s $599 MacBook Neo turned out to be the catalyst Microsoft needed to fix Windows 11, after years of gamers, IT admins, and everyday users complaining that the OS felt slower and heavier.

feed.titleEn: KISDI, 교사 대상 'AI 윤리 수업 실습 연수 챌린지 페스타' 개최
feed.descEn: (서울=뉴스1) 나연준 기자 = 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)은 지난달 말 전국 초·중·고 교사를 대상으로 'AI 윤리 수업 실습 연수 챌린지 페스타'를 개최했다고 5일 밝혔다. 과학기술정보통신부가 주최하고 KISDI가 주관하는 이번 연수는 오는 11일 2회차를 포함해 총 2회에 걸쳐 진행되며, 각 시·도 교육청 공문 등을 통해 사전 신청한 교사 107
summaryLinesEn: 과학기술정보통신부가 주최하고 KISDI가 주관하는 이번 연수는 오는 11일 2회차를 포함해 총 2회에 걸쳐 진행되며, 각 시·도 교육청 공문 등을 통해 사전 신청한 교사 107여 명이 참여한다.
실시간 트렌드 데이터는 안정화 기간 중 베타(Beta) 서비스로 운영하며, 01:00~06:00에는 데이터 수집 규모와 이용률이 낮아 제한적으로 제공합니다.
정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)은 지난달 말 전국 초·중·고 교사를 대상으로 'AI 윤리 수업 실습 연수 챌린지 페스타'를 개최했다고 5일 밝혔다.

feed.title: US Market Pulse August 2026
feed.desc: US Market Pulse August 2026    Goldman Sachs Asset Management
feed.titleEn: US Market Pulse August 2026
feed.descEn: The Market Pulse highlights the latest market developments and trends, coupled with insights on portfolio construction.
summaryLinesEn: In the US, we expect core inflation closer to 3% in December 2026 given the effects of tariffs, energy prices, and AI measurement issues, with it falling closer to 2% in 2027 as those subside.
We estimate that over time 7% of jobs are likely to be displaced, but leading AI labs have suggested that the technology can do just 2-3% of all jobs today.

Significant AI capex requires a mix of financing, with hyperscaler issuance accounting for 16-23% of gross issuance in USD IG, HY, and leveraged loan markets YTD, and a growing share of non-USD and private markets as well.

localization.title: 2026년 8월 미국 시장 동향
summaryLines: 미국에서는 관세, 에너지 가격, AI 측정 문제의 영향을 고려할 때 2026년 12월 근원 인플레이션이 3%에 가까워질 것으로 예상하고, 이러한 요인이 가라앉으면서 2027년에는 2%에 가까워질 것으로 예상됨
우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 일자리의 7%가 대체될 가능성이 있다고 추정하지만, 주요 AI 연구소에서는 현재 이 기술이 전체 일자리의 2~3%만 수행할 수 있다고 제안함
상당한 AI 투자에는 하이퍼스케일러 발행이 USD IG, HY 및 레버리지 대출 시장 YTD에서 총 발행의 16~23%를 차지하고 비 USD 및 민간 시장의 점유율도 증가하는 등 혼합 자금 조달이 필요함

feed.title: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground
feed.desc: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground
feed.descEn: For more than a decade, cloud‑first was the defining posture of enterprise technology leadership. It helped organizations unlock scale, flexibility, and speed at a time when digital transformation was primarily about modernization and cost efficiency. That era has now reached maturity. Today, we are at a far more consequential inflection point.
summaryLinesEn: Recent research into enterprise AI adoption reveals a striking paradox: the majority of generative AI initiatives stall before reaching production, and even fewer scale to deliver enterprise‑wide value.
The Productivity Paradox: Why AI Spending Isn’t Paying Off Across Fortune 100 organizations, AI investment is accelerating.

In an AI‑first enterprise, technology operations recede from executive attention, not because they are deprioritized, but because they perform with such consistency that they no longer demand intervention.

feed.title: AI Server Shipments Forecast Raised to Nearly 31% YoY in 2026 as 90% Surge in CSP CapEx Fuels Infrastructure Expansion, Says TrendForce
feed.desc: AI Server Shipments Forecast Raised to Nearly 31% YoY in 2026 as 90% Surge in CSP CapEx Fuels Infrastructure Expansion, Says TrendForce    TrendForce
feed.titleEn: AI Server Shipments Forecast Raised to Nearly 31% YoY in 2026 as 90% Surge in CSP CapEx Fuels Infrastructure Expansion, Says TrendForce
feed.descEn: Surging investment in AI infrastructure is expected to drive the combined CapEx of the world’s nine largest CSPs up by approximately 90% YoY in 2026, according to TrendForce’s latest AI server research.
summaryLinesEn: TrendForce estimates that the combined 2026 CapEx of Google, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu will exceed US$886.7 billion, with the five North American hyperscalers accounting for nearly 90%.
TrendForce has therefore revised its 2026 AI server shipment forecast upward from 28% to nearly 31% YoY.
Looking to 2027, TrendForce estimates that the combined CapEx of the top nine CSPs will hit about $1.3 trillion, showing nearly 50% year-over-year growth.

summaryLinesEn: NXP generated 17% of its revenue from China and 55% from the automotive market, leaving it particularly exposed, UBS said.

That contrasted with a 25% increase in NXP's Chinese revenue during the second quarter, raising the risk that customers had accumulated excessive chip inventories ahead of a correction in 2027.

feed.descEn: ServetIA is an AI-powered research platform developed for the Spanish Prime Minister’s Office to help government staff conduct faster, more thorough policy rese...
summaryLinesEn: PresidencIA: Generative AI Adoption Programme for the Spanish Prime Minister’s Office Leveraging on 3 pillars (Community, Applications and Infrastructure), PresidencIA builds AI literacy among staff through workshops, community and best practices, develops custom AI tools for processes in the PM’s Office, and pursues on-premises AI infrastructure for tech sovereignty.

A specific programme for the development of AI skills (under development at the time of writing) will be launched as part of the national plan for digital competency enhancement (Plan Nacional de Competencias Digitales).
A study on the impact of AI use on vulnerable collectives was expected to be conducted in Q4 2024.

feed.title: WHO and ITU launch AI initiative to expand digital support for noncommunicable disease care
feed.desc: WHO and ITU launch AI initiative to expand digital support for noncommunicable disease care    Tech Review Africa
feed.titleEn: WHO and ITU launch AI initiative to expand digital support for noncommunicable disease care
feed.descEn: Your Trusted Tech News Platform
summaryLinesEn: According to project partners, artificial intelligence will support the design and delivery of more personalized digital health interventions while helping health systems expand their capacity to provide preventive care and behavioural support.

Through BHBM 2.0, WHO and ITU aim to demonstrate how responsible AI adoption can strengthen public health systems, improve access to healthcare information and support individuals in making healthier lifestyle choices.

The joint initiative, known as BHBM 2.0 , aims to use AI-driven solutions to strengthen digital health services and address gaps in the delivery of behavioural interventions for people affected by or at risk of noncommunicable diseases.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs Says This Is Where Microsoft's AI Investments Begin to Pay Off Big Time
feed.desc: Goldman Sachs Says This Is Where Microsoft’s AI Investments Begin to Pay Off Big Time    24/7 Wall St.
feed.titleEn: Goldman Sachs Says This Is Where Microsoft's AI Investments Begin to Pay Off Big Time
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs just made a bold call that the biggest AI profits are no longer coming from chips and data centers, and one software giant sits at the center of that shift.
summaryLinesEn: Goldman projects Microsoft's EPS growth accelerates from roughly 12% in fiscal 2027 to over 20% by fiscal 2029 as Copilot adoption scales.
Azure surpassed $100 billion in annual revenue growing at 43%, making it the engine behind Microsoft's shift to recurring AI-powered subscription revenue.

Goldman Sachs believes Microsoft ( NASDAQ:MSFT | MSFT Price Prediction ) is among the best positioned to benefit because it already has AI woven into the software businesses millions of workers use every day.

feed.title: Generative AI Use Cases Dominating Enterprise Tech in North America
feed.desc: Generative AI Use Cases Dominating Enterprise Tech in North America    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: Generative AI Use Cases Dominating Enterprise Tech in North America
feed.descEn: The numbers no longer leave room for debate.
summaryLinesEn: <According to Gartner's 2026 forecast, over 80% of enterprises now deploy generative AI applications, and global AI spending has reached $2.59 trillion — a 47% annual increase that marks the clearest signal yet that artificial intelligence development has crossed from experimental novelty into enterprise infrastructure.

Nowhere is this shift more pronounced than in North America, where Fortune 500 companies, fast-scaling mid-market firms, and tech-native startups alike have moved decisively from cautious pilots into production-grade deployments.
Research indicates artificial intelligence development in this space could deliver R&D cost savings of 10–15%, with global adoption in product development expected to reach 46% by 2026.

feed.titleEn: A five-step roadmap to closing the AI evaluation gap
feed.descEn: A five-step roadmap for closing the AI evaluation gap to strengthen trust, security, adoption and effective AI governance.
summaryLinesEn: Following the establishment in 2023 of AI Safety Institutes by the UK and the US[SR1] [SR2] (both renamed in 2025), a total of 11 jurisdictions, including the EU, India and Singapore, have now followed a similar model and established AI safety institutes or similar organisations that conduct testing and evaluation of foundation models.
This includes the efforts of safety institutes and standards organisations, such as the “ Zero Draft ” project launched by NIST to expedite the standards process.

feed.titleEn: Diverging Memory Market Outlook in 2027 as DRAM Supply Remains Tight While NAND Flash Supply Conditions Ease, Says TrendForce
feed.descEn: TrendForce’s latest research on the memory industry reveals that AI will remain the primary driver of memory demand in 2027. However, market dynamics are expected to diverge between DRAM and NAND Flash.
summaryLinesEn: TrendForce’s latest research on the memory industry reveals that AI will remain the primary driver of memory demand in 2027.
TrendForce expects the NAND Flash market to undergo a structural shift in 2027 as new capacity gradually enters production while consumer demand remains weak.

By contrast, NAND Flash is projected to enter a looser supply environment in 2H27 as new production capacity comes online while consumer electronics demand remains weak, increasing downward pressure on prices.

feed.title: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand
feed.desc: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand    Yahoo Finance

sourceContent.headline: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand
sourceContent.description: The research firm now expects global technology spending to reach $6.37 trillion this year, up 14.2% from 2025.
paragraphs: Global information technology spending will reach $6.37 trillion in 2026, Gartner said Monday, raising its forecast as organizations ramp up their artificial intelligence investments.

"Driven by the expansion of AI workloads and demand for high-performance computing, hyperscalers and enterprises are rapidly scaling next-generation data center capacity," Lovelock said in the Monday release.
The latest projection represents a 14.2% increase from 2025 and an upward revision from Gartner's previous forecast of $6.31 trillion in April.

The latest projection represents a 14.2% increase from 2025 and an upward revision from Gartner's previous forecast of $6.31 trillion in April.

feed.title: Big Tech will fund more than a third of its AI investments with debt in 2027, Goldman Sachs predicts
feed.desc: Big Tech will fund more than a third of its AI investments with debt in 2027, Goldman Sachs predicts    Yahoo Finance

sourceContent.headline: Big Tech will fund more than a third of its AI investments with debt in 2027, Goldman Sachs predicts
sourceContent.description: Hyperscalers are expected to fund an increasing amount of their capex with debt.
paragraphs: In 2027, Goldman Sachs said, the share of debt-funded capex is likely to rise even further, with $400 billion in expected global IG bond issuance from the hyperscalers against an estimated $1.14 trillion in capex, or a roughly 35% share.

"While we do not expect all of this debt to be issued in the traditional IG corporate bond markets, there is scope, in our view, for the hyperscalers to lean more into broader debt financing channels to support AI-related capital investments," the strategists wrote.
By year end for 2026, that figure is expected to reach $750 billion, per Goldman Sachs, before nearing $1.2 trillion in 2027.

feed.desc: The ITU's AI for Good Lab launches to help developing economies scale responsible AI    Yahoo Finance

sourceContent.headline: The ITU's AI for Good Lab launches to help developing economies scale responsible AI
sourceContent.description: The ITU's AI for Good Lab forms part of the implementation agenda of the United Nations AI for Good Impact Initiative, helping developing and emerging economies move beyond isolated AI pilot projects and build the policy, skills and public infrastructure needed to deploy locally relevant AI solutions responsibly and at scale.
paragraphs: It also works with the African Telecommunications Union, national governments and ITU regional offices to establish local hubs and scale successful projects.

Announced during the AI for Good Global Summit 2026 in Geneva, the Lab brings together three interconnected areas of support: national AI readiness and policy, skills development and public AI infrastructure.
Ebtesam Almazrouei, Chairperson of the United Nations AI for Good Impact Initiative, said: "Artificial intelligence is entering its implementation decade.

feed.desc: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand    CFO Dive
feed.titleEn: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand
feed.descEn: The research firm now expects global technology spending to reach $6.37 trillion this year, up 14.2% from 2025.
summaryLinesEn: Global information technology spending will reach $6.37 trillion in 2026, Gartner said Monday, raising its forecast as organizations ramp up their artificial intelligence investments.

“Driven by the expansion of AI workloads and demand for high-performance computing, hyperscalers and enterprises are rapidly scaling next-generation data center capacity,” Lovelock said in the Monday release.
The latest projection represents a 14.2% increase from 2025 and an upward revision from Gartner’s previous forecast of $6.31 trillion in April.

feed.title: JPMorgan's AI leadership is getting a reset. These are the key players.
feed.desc: JPMorgan’s AI leadership is getting a reset. These are the key players.    Business Insider
feed.titleEn: JPMorgan's AI leadership is getting a reset. These are the key players.
feed.descEn: After the firm's AI chief stepped down earlier this month, JPMorgan has reshuffled the ranks of its AI leadership.
summaryLinesEn: CEO Jamie Dimon said on a recent earnings call that there are already more than 1,000 use cases for AI, and Business Insider previously reported that JPMorgan can track individual engineers' token usage.

It's more than just job titles shifting around — JPMorgan said it's restructuring its firm-wide chief data and analytics office as it transitions from focusing on AI infrastructure to business initiatives.
The bank, with its nearly $20 billion technology budget, has been especially bullish on AI.

This means shifting the organisational focus from training completion to capability activation: embedding AI skills directly into live projects, not just learning programmes.

feed.desc: NVIDIA and Broadcom Begin Volume Ramp of CPO Switches, with Optical Engine Yield and Advanced Packaging Capacity Emerging as Key Expansion Bottlenecks, Says TrendForce    TrendForce
feed.titleEn: NVIDIA and Broadcom Begin Volume Ramp of CPO Switches, with Optical Engine Yield and Advanced Packaging Capacity Emerging as Key Expansion Bottlenecks, Says TrendForce
feed.descEn: TrendForce's latest research on the optical communications industry reveals that NVIDIA has begun shipping its next-generation Spectrum-X CPO switch to select partners. Meanwhile, Broadcom is continuing limited shipments of its 51.2T Bailly CPO switch, marking the official transition of co-packaged optics (CPO) into the mass production phase.
summaryLinesEn: TrendForce notes that the Spectrum-X CPO switch—jointly developed by NVIDIA and TSMC—utilizes TSMC's COUPE advanced packaging technology and delivers up to 400 Tb/s of switching capacity.
Meanwhile, Broadcom is continuing limited shipments of its 51.2T Bailly CPO switch, marking the official transition of co-packaged optics (CPO) into the mass production phase.
Broadcom's 51.2T Bailly CPO switch has entered volume manufacturing with support from Delta Electronics and Micas Networks.

feed.title: 総務省が「自治体AX研究会」を始動。浜松市と神戸市でAI実証、自律型AIエージェントの導入も論点に
feed.desc: 総務省が「自治体AX研究会」を始動。浜松市と神戸市でAI実証、自律型AIエージェントの導入も論点に    innovaTopia
feed.titleEn: 総務省が「自治体AX研究会」を始動。浜松市と神戸市でAI実証、自律型AIエージェントの導入も論点に
feed.descEn: 総務省が2026年7月9日、自治体AX研究会の第1回会合を開催した。浜松市の住民基本台帳業務と神戸市の生活保護業務を実証フィールドとし、AIによる業務の代替可能性を検証する。AIエージェントの類型整理から自律型AIのガバナンス、行政処分と人の関与まで、公開資料から論点を読み解く。
summaryLinesEn: 人手不足が深刻化する自治体業務について、AIによる代替・補助の可能性を検証し、業務の構造変革を展望することが目的である。
総務省は2026年7月9日、「地方自治体におけるAIトランスフォーメーションに関する研究会」（通称・自治体AX研究会）の第1回会合を開いた。
2026年度（令和8年度）は、浜松市の住民基本台帳業務と神戸市の生活保護業務を実証フィールドとする。

paragraphs: 人手不足が深刻化する自治体業務について、AIによる代替・補助の可能性を検証し、業務の構造変革を展望することが目的である。
総務省は2026年7月9日、「地方自治体におけるAIトランスフォーメーションに関する研究会」（通称・自治体AX研究会）の第1回会合を開いた。
2026年度（令和8年度）は、浜松市の住民基本台帳業務と神戸市の生活保護業務を実証フィールドとする。

feed.title: Three New Stock Themes Are in Focus as the AI Trade Gyrates
feed.desc: Three New Stock Themes Are in Focus as the AI Trade Gyrates    Goldman Sachs
feed.titleEn: Three New Stock Themes Are in Focus as the AI Trade Gyrates
feed.descEn: As volatility rises in popular stocks related to AI infrastructure, investors are looking for trade ideas that are unrelated to the emerging technology. Goldman Sachs Research highlights consumer-experience companies, “compounder” stocks, and M&A candidates as potential themes for investors to consider.
summaryLinesEn: The volume of announced US M&A has risen 32% to $1.2 trillion in 2026 (year over year, as of July 17).
These equities trade at undemanding valuations and have limited risk from AI disruption.

Goldman Sachs Research highlights three investment ideas that are unrelated to AI and have minimal correlation to those stocks: consumer-experience companies, “compounders,” and candidates for mergers and acquisitions.

feed.desc: How Is Erica Powering Bank of America's Digital Banking Momentum?    The Globe and Mail
feed.titleEn: How Is Erica Powering Bank of America's Digital Banking Momentum?
feed.descEn: Detailed price information for Wells Fargo & Company (WFC-N) from The Globe and Mail including charting and trades.
summaryLinesEn: Bank of America’s Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates In the past six months, BAC shares have gained 17.8% compared with the industry ’s 12.6% growth.

Its virtual assistant, Fargo, recently surpassed 1 billion customer interactions in less than three years, while the bank exceeded 33 million mobile active users, underscoring strong customer adoption of its digital platform.

JPM’s CEO Jamie Dimon also highlighted during the second-quarter earnings call that the bank now has nearly 1,000 live AI use cases spanning fraud detection, risk management, marketing and customer service, reflecting JPMorgan’s broad enterprise-wide AI strategy.

feed.title: L-Day: Implementation of the OECD Pillar Two Side-by-Side package
feed.desc: L-Day: Implementation of the OECD Pillar Two Side-by-Side package    kpmg.com
feed.titleEn: L-Day: Implementation of the OECD Pillar Two Side-by-Side package
feed.descEn: The draft legislation updates the UK’s multinational and domestic top-up taxes legislation for recent OECD developments
summaryLinesEn: A ministerial statement on 7 January 2026 confirmed that the Side-by-Side package was to be implemented by the 2026-27 Finance Bill and, as updating aspects of the multinational and domestic top-up taxes legislation has been a feature of every Finance Act since those taxes were enacted, there was no surprise that these measures were included in the L-Day announcement.
This reduces the risk of that territory having an ETR below 15 percent that may potentially trigger MTT.

There are some exceptions (for example, grants or direct subsidies cannot be a QTI) and the amount that can be excluded is capped at 5.5 percent of the group’s eligible payroll costs in the territory (or, if higher, 5.5 percent of its depreciation that is used to determine the group’s eligible tangible net asset amounts in the territory).

localization.title: L-Day: OECD Pillar Two Side-by-Side 패키지 구현
summaryLines: 2026년 1월 7일 장관 성명에서는 병렬 패키지가 2026-27년 재정 법안에 의해 시행될 것임을 확인했으며, 다국적 및 국내 추가 세금 법안의 업데이트 측면이 해당 세금이 제정된 이후 모든 금융법의 특징이 되었기 때문에 이러한 조치가 L-Day 발표에 포함된 것은 놀라운 일이 아님
이렇게 하면 잠재적으로 MTT를 유발할 수 있는 ETR이 15% 미만인 해당 지역의 위험이 줄어듬
몇 가지 예외가 있으며(예 · 보조금이나 직접 보조금은 QTI가 될 수 없음) 제외할 수 있는 금액은 해당 지역에서 그룹의 적격 급여 비용의 5.5%(또는 더 높은 경우 해당 지역에서 그룹의 적격 유형 순자산 금액을 결정하는 데 사용되는 감가상각비의 5.5%)로 제한됨

feed.titleEn: JPMorgan owns AI answers. Here's how rivals can compete
feed.descEn: A study of consumer-banking queries fielded by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews found the nation's largest bank has nearly a third of the models' mindshare.
summaryLinesEn: The top-performing 20 public banks with under $2B of assets in 2025 How a serial borrower fooled 7 banks out of $39 million "Obviously their marketing engines are anemic compared to what Chase is doing," he said.
Showing up in AI answers is increasingly important for banks as consumers shift from Google searches to AI models (including Google AI Overviews) when they need information.
JPMorganChase was cited in 28% of the models' answers, though its market share of U.S. consumer deposits is only around 17%.

sourceContent.description: Wall Street giant adjusts emerging market asset allocation recommendation, identifying China as benefiting from a broadening market rally.
paragraphs: The bank acknowledged that while China’s relative earnings-per-share momentum remained a weak spot following a cautious start to the year, the market now screens as a prime candidate for capital rotation.

“If the macro environment remains favourable, including easing geopolitical risks, there is scope for broadening,” a team of strategists including David Groman noted in a July 20, research report, pointing to cooling AI sentiment and elevated volatility alongside solid tech earnings growth as setting the stage for a potential rotation.

Wall Street giant adjusts emerging market asset allocation recommendation, identifying China as benefiting from a broadening market rally Wall Street giant Citigroup has adjusted its emerging market asset allocation recommendation, upgrading China to “overweight”, saying that investors should increase their exposure to assets that could benefit from a broadening market rally.

localization.title: AI 변동성과 지정학적 마찰 속에서 Citi는 중국에 투자
summaryLines: 은행은 올해를 조심스럽게 시작한 이후 중국의 상대적인 주당 순이익 모멘텀이 여전히 약점으로 남아 있지만 이제 시장이 자본 순환의 주요 후보로 거론되고 있음을 인정함
데이비드 그로먼(David Groman)을 포함한 전략가 팀은 7월 20일 연구 보고서에서 "지정학적 위험 완화를 포함해 거시적 환경이 계속 우호적이라면 확장의 여지가 있다"고 언급하면서 견실한 기술 수익 성장과 함께 AI 정서 냉각 및 변동성 증가가 잠재적 순환의 발판을 마련했다고 지적함
월스트리트 거대 기업, 신흥 시장 자산 배분 권장 사항 조정, 중국이 시장 랠리 확대로 혜택을 누릴 수 있다고 확인

sourceContent.headline: Morgan Stanley Turned AI Into Wall Street’s Hottest Bond Trade
sourceContent.description: Morgan Stanley leads a $570 billion AI bond market boom as pension funds and insurers bankroll data centers in 2026.
paragraphs: Morgan Stanley expects AI companies to raise $570 billion from the bond market in 2026.
Data centers need $2.9 trillion through 2028, and Big Tech's cash covers only half of that, Morgan Stanley estimates.
It led $65 billion in AI bond deals in late 2025 alone, according to Bloomberg.
